description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grain versioning strategies, including minimum, latest, all compatible, and random compatible version selection strategies. It defines multiple test classes that verify behavior such as activation versions, upgrades, and distribution of grain activations across versions.

classes.name: MinimumVersionTests
classes.description: Test class ensuring grains activate with minimum version (v1) regardless of silo deployment.

classes.name: LatestVersionTests
classes.description: Test class verifying grains activate with the latest version (v2) and upgrade behavior.

classes.name: AllVersionsCompatibleTests
classes.description: Test class ensuring that compatible versions do not trigger upgrades when they are compatible.

classes.name: RandomCompatibleVersionTests
classes.description: Test class verifying distribution of grain activations across multiple versions using a random compatible strategy.

methods.name: AlwaysCreateActivationWithMinimumVersion
methods.description: Test method verifying that only v1 grains are activated even after v2 silo deployment.

methods.name: AlwaysCreateActivationWithLatestVersion
methods.description: Test method verifying that grains activate with the latest version (v2) after deployment.

methods.name: UpgradeProxyCallNoPendingRequest
methods.description: Test method verifying upgrade behavior when no pending request exists.

methods.name: UpgradeProxyCallWithPendingRequest
methods.description: Test method verifying upgrade behavior when a request is already in progress.

methods.name: DoNotUpgradeProxyCallNoPendingRequest
methods.description: Test method verifying that compatible versions do not trigger upgrades when no pending request.

methods.name: DoNotUpgradeProxyCallWithPendingRequest
methods.description: Test method verifying that compatible versions do not trigger upgrades when a request is in progress.

methods.name: CreateActivationWithBothVersion
methods.description: Test method verifying that activations are distributed across both versions (v1 and v2) with a roughly equal probability.
